description: Add an allow/deny scope rule. A 'deny' rule tightens (free); an 'allow' rule loosens and requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required true for an 'allow' rule (loosens scope).

label.description: Optional human label for the rule.

pattern.description: URL/domain glob the rule matches, e.g. 'api.example.com/*'.

name: xenarch_agent_add_scope_rule
